lesson: The trade failed because the 1h/1d bullish structure was insufficient to overcome the 4h bearish momentum, leading to a liquidity sweep rather than a reversal. The system incorrectly prioritized lower-timeframe absorption over the dominant 4h trend structure.
adjustment: Require a confirmed 4h market structure break (MSB) before entering long positions, regardless of 1h bullish patterns.
methodology_flag: Trust 4h trend structure over 1h Wyckoff accumulation patterns on ZECUSDT.
